sloka: विवेष्टमाना पतिता समुद्रे जनक आत्मजा ।आहो क्षुद्रेण च अनेन रक्षन्ती शीलम् आत्मनः ॥५-१३-११॥
transliteration: viveṣṭamānā patitā samudre janaka ātmajā ।āho kṣudreṇa ca anena rakṣantī śīlam ātmanaḥ ॥5-13-11॥

translations.english: "Oh poor Sita, distanced from relations, while protecting her chastity helplessly she might have been devoured by cruel Ravana.
